newsitem.title: INDIA: India allows advance document filing for air cargo.
newsitem.headline: India allows advance document filing for air cargo.

text.p: The Finance Ministry said importers can now file import clearance documents 30 days in advance of the arrival of an aircraft, government officials said.
Goods can be assessed and duty paid before arrival for immediate clearance, they added.

Electronic industry sources said they welcomed the move as it will overcome problems -- particularly in the electronics parts sector -- where companies have been kept waiting for urgent imports to meet foreign export orders on product lines.
The officials also said companies should save foreign exchange on charges by foreign shipping companies due to reduced delays and charges.
They added that officially registered export companies are now to be allowed to automatically to sub-contract work out without affecting their customs status.

Additionally private bonded warehouse applications will get automatic approval provided they meet the normal guidelines rather than seeking special clearance, they said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
